answer: That makes each additional alias in a cluster strictly dilutive, so the operator pays the bond and the crystal fee for a smaller payout than one honest position would earn. Because the lotus cluster is derived from funding history, the split is applied at settlement and the summit audit lists each share. The reward pool is divided per detected cluster rather than per key, so 148 linked identities split one share instead of collecting 148 of them. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
